methodology: ESPN's current 600-player status feed is refreshed first. Curated overrides are then used only when a dated team or league report is newer or more specific than the provider label. Rank penalties affect the live decision board, while original consensus rank and official Boris tier remain visible for comparison. An override is revised or cleared when a newer report changes the player's outlook.

entries.headline: Knee monitored after he did not suit up for September 2 practice
entries.detail: The team has not announced an absence, but Chase's practice participation now warrants a minimal Week 1 readiness adjustment until the official game-status report is filed.

entries.headline: Torn ACL; expected to miss the 2026 season
entries.detail: The season-ending designation removes Higgins from optimized draft plans, sets his 2026 availability and projection to zero, and moves him to the bottom live tier.

entries.headline: Sprained MCL; expected to miss at least one month
entries.detail: The live board discounts his draft rank and season-long weekly expectation for missed early-season time while retaining his healthy-game PPG as context.

entries.headline: Season-ending PCL surgery; placed on injured reserve
entries.detail: Pearsall is excluded from every 2026 optimized draft plan and assigned zero expected weekly production.

entries.headline: Season-ending LCL surgery; rookie year over
entries.detail: Carolina announced that Brazzell will miss the full 2026 season, so the live boards and plans assign zero availability.

entries.headline: Placed on injured reserve; current tracker lists no 2026 return
entries.detail: Ford is treated as unavailable until Washington supplies a return designation. The dated override can be relaxed immediately if that changes.

entries.headline: Reserve/PUP confirmed; will miss at least four games
entries.detail: Seattle placed Charbonnet on Reserve/PUP at final cuts. He cannot play before Week 5, so the season projection and live rank now reflect a guaranteed four-game absence while healthy-game PPG remains visible.

entries.headline: Hamstring injury; expected to miss roughly two months
entries.detail: The latest league report points to a multi-game absence extending well beyond Week 1. His healthy-game ceiling stays visible, but the season projection and live rank reflect the expected missed time.

entries.headline: Knee recovery remains a Week 1 concern after another missed practice
entries.detail: Monangai did not practice on September 3. The board now carries a larger short-term availability adjustment until Chicago publishes its official Week 1 designation.

entries.headline: Trending toward Week 1, but an Achilles-related snap limit remains possible
entries.detail: Kittle is expected to travel and is trending toward playing, though current reporting leaves open the possibility of a managed workload. The board applies a moderate readiness discount, not a multi-game absence.

entries.headline: Coach optimistic for Week 1 as ankle recovery continues
entries.detail: Las Vegas remains optimistic Jeanty can play in the opener. The model keeps only a small readiness discount while awaiting the official game designation.

entries.headline: Still on Commissioner's Exempt List; return date remains unknown
entries.detail: This is an availability designation rather than an injury. Jacobs cannot practice or play while exempt, and Green Bay has only expressed hope that he can return sometime this season. His September 10 court date is after this draft, so the board now applies a larger uncertainty discount.

entries.headline: On track to start Week 1 after strong ACL-rehab camp
entries.detail: Mahomes remains a post-ACL monitoring case, but the latest national report says he is on track for the opener. The model retains only a minimal readiness adjustment; his historical durability signal remains separate.

entries.headline: Ankle issue remains unsettled after a missed September 3 practice
entries.detail: A prior report expected Henderson to be ready, but the newer missed practice reopens Week 1 workload uncertainty. The model restores a modest readiness discount pending the official designation.

entries.headline: Groin recovery remains on track for Week 1
entries.detail: New York still expects Hall to be available for the opener. The model keeps a small readiness and possible early workload discount rather than the undifferentiated ESPN questionable penalty.

entries.headline: Returned to team drills after hip flare-up
entries.detail: LaPorta returned to practice and took team repetitions, materially improving the earlier uncertain Week 1 outlook. A minimal readiness discount remains until regular-season injury reports begin.

entries.headline: Removed from Active/PUP; cleared to begin practicing
entries.detail: Indianapolis activated Pierce on August 27. He still needs a post-surgery ramp-up, but the prior risk of an automatic four-game PUP absence is gone and the live board now carries only a minimal readiness discount.

entries.headline: Groin issue still monitored after side work in team drills
entries.detail: Nacua worked off to the side during team periods on August 31. His elite role remains intact, but the board retains a small readiness adjustment until full Week 1 participation is confirmed.

entries.headline: ACL rehab advancing through individual and team drills
entries.detail: Nabers participated in individual and team work on September 2. Week 1 is not guaranteed, but the new practice progress reduces the earlier rehab-stage discount.

entries.headline: High-ankle recovery progressing, but Week 1 remains uncertain
entries.detail: Love is making progress as of September 3, but high-ankle recovery and lost preseason work still justify a meaningful availability discount until he returns to full practice.

entries.headline: Adductor issue improving after a return to practice
entries.detail: Warren practiced on September 1. No extended absence has been announced, so the model applies only a minimal readiness adjustment.

entries.headline: Toe recovery trending positively in side-field running
entries.detail: Egbuka ran on the side on September 2 without obvious difficulty. The role-based upside remains, with a modest adjustment retained until full practice participation is confirmed.

entries.headline: Abdominal issue believed to have been cramping
entries.detail: Current reporting does not indicate a serious injury or expected absence. The note remains visible without materially changing Swift's season projection.

entries.headline: Returned to practice after lower-body issue
entries.detail: Flowers returned on September 3 after roughly two weeks away. The board carries only a minimal readiness adjustment while awaiting the official Week 1 designation.

entries.headline: Heel issue kept him out of September 2 practice
entries.detail: No extended absence has been announced, but the missed practice warrants a modest Week 1 readiness adjustment until Cincinnati files its official designation.

entries.headline: Illness caused a missed September 2 practice
entries.detail: The issue is illness rather than a structural injury. The model applies a small short-term adjustment that should clear quickly if Tuten resumes practice.

entries.headline: Leg issue expected to be minor
entries.detail: Current reporting says Odunze should be all good. The news remains visible without a material season-long projection penalty.

entries.headline: Groin recovery trending toward practice
entries.detail: Chicago planned for Burden to return to practice this week. Only a minimal readiness adjustment remains until that return is confirmed.

entries.headline: Stiffness caused a missed September 1 practice
entries.detail: The club has not announced an extended absence. The board applies a small readiness adjustment pending his return to practice.

entries.headline: Returned to practice from groin issue
entries.detail: Evans returned on September 2. The board retains only a minimal readiness adjustment while waiting for the official Week 1 report.

entries.headline: Expected to be ready for Week 1
entries.detail: Current reporting expects Metcalf to play in the opener. The injury remains visible but does not receive a meaningful rank penalty.

entries.headline: Expected to be ready for Week 1
entries.detail: Current reporting expects Pittman to play in the opener. The injury remains visible but does not receive a meaningful rank penalty.

entries.headline: Calf issue improved enough for a return to practice
entries.detail: Downs practiced on September 1. The board retains only a minimal readiness adjustment pending the official game designation.

entries.headline: ACL recovery trending toward Week 1 availability
entries.detail: Kraft is trending in the right direction as of September 3. A small workload-readiness adjustment remains until Green Bay confirms his game status.

entries.headline: Hamstring recovery; targeting the opener
entries.detail: Carolina still lists Hubbard first on the depth chart, but is planning a Hubbard/Jonathon Brooks rotation once both are available. The current rank accounts for both the hamstring and shared-workload risk.

entries.headline: Returned to practice after planned workload management
entries.detail: The current report says the missed practices were planned rather than a new injury setback. No current availability penalty is applied; historical durability risk remains separate.

entries.headline: Cleared after head evaluation; dealing with a stinger
entries.detail: Tracy was evaluated for a head injury and cleared. The current concern is a stinger, so the generic OUT penalty from the provider feed is replaced with a small short-term readiness adjustment.

entries.headline: Head evaluation did not indicate a concussion; still monitored
entries.detail: Tennessee does not believe Robinson suffered a concussion, but will continue monitoring for delayed symptoms. The board keeps the injury visible with only a minimal readiness adjustment.

entries.headline: Held out with an ankle injury; no long-term concern reported
entries.detail: Minnesota held McCarthy out of the preseason finale, but the current report says there is no long-term concern. The model applies only a minimal readiness adjustment.

entries.headline: Knee issue continues to limit him ahead of Week 1
entries.detail: McMillan remained sidelined as of September 1. The board applies a moderate readiness adjustment until he returns to team practice.

entries.headline: Placed on injured reserve with a back injury; no return timetable
entries.detail: Pacheco is unavailable for at least four games and currently has no announced return timetable. He is modeled as an IR stash rather than usable early-season depth.

entries.headline: Placed on injured reserve with an ankle injury and designated to return
entries.detail: Etienne cannot play during the first four games. He remains a later-season stash candidate, but the draft model discounts the guaranteed early absence.

entries.headline: Placed on IR with a return designation; out at least four games
entries.detail: San Francisco designated Kirk to return from injured reserve. He remains eligible later in the season, but the final-cut designation guarantees that he cannot play in the first four games.

entries.headline: Reserve/PUP confirmed; out at least four games
entries.detail: Guerendo remained on Reserve/PUP at final roster cuts, making him ineligible for the first four games. He is now modeled as an IR-stash candidate rather than usable early-season depth.

entries.headline: Placed on IR with a return designation; out at least four games
entries.detail: Houston designated Dell to return from injured reserve. He can return later in the season, but he is not eligible to play during the first four games and should be treated as an IR stash on draft day.
